controles.affirmation: L'EPA a transmis le dossier Uncle Sam au DOJ pour examen de pénalités contractuelles ; discussions en cours.
controles.verbatim_source: EPA has alleged that the Company failed to comply with certain requirements of the Consent Decree and referred the matter to the U.S. Department of Justice for consideration of stipulated penalties. Discussions with EPA Region 6 and the Department of Justice are ongoing. (10-Q T2 2026, Item 1)

controles.affirmation: Premier reexamen quinquennal des CVD initie le 2 mars 2026 ; suspension presidentielle de 8 mois des CVD marocains le 29 juin 2026.
controles.verbatim_source: DOC and the ITC are also conducting the first five-year sunset reviews of the CVD orders, which were initiated on March 2, 2026 / The President directed DOC to temporarily suspend collection of CVDs on imports of phosphate fertilizer from Morocco for a period of eight months

controles.affirmation: Resume : 'protege par des ordonnances antidumping sur les importations marocaines et russes'
controles.verbatim_source: In April 2021, the U.S. Department of Commerce issued countervailing duty (CVD) orders on imports of phosphate fertilizers from Morocco and Russia. Le mot antidumping n'apparait nulle part dans le 10-Q.
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer 'antidumping' par 'droits compensateurs (CVD)'. Ce sont deux instruments juridiques distincts : le CVD vise les subventions, l'antidumping vise la vente sous le prix normal.

controles.affirmation: Araxa : 'une depreciation additionnelle de 232,6 M$ figure sur les actifs classes en vente au bilan du 30 juin 2026'
controles.verbatim_source: resulting in an impairment charge of approximately $233 million ... No additional impairment was recognized during the second quarter of 2026 (note Araxa) ; In the first quarter of 2026 ... This resulted in an impairment loss of approximately $232.6 million
controles.correction_proposee: Les 232,6 M$ ont ete comptabilises au T1 2026 et sont deja inclus dans les ~482 M$ cites juste avant ; aucune depreciation additionnelle n'a ete constatee au T2. Ecrire : 'dont 232,6 M$ de depreciation du groupe destine a la vente, comptabilises des le premier trimestre'.

controles.affirmation: Charges Araxa/Patrocinio d'environ 482 M$ sur le S1 2026, dont 72 + 56 + 21 + 10 M$ au T1.
controles.verbatim_source: which resulted in additional expense of approximately $482 million / These charges consisted of approximately $72 million for contract termination costs, $56 million for the write-off of property, plant and equipment, $21 million write-off of inventory and other assets, and $10 million for severance

controles.affirmation: Perte nette de 272,8 M$ (-0,86 $/action) au T2 2026 contre 410,7 M$ (+1,29 $) ; marge brute 8% contre 17% ; perte semestrielle 530,4 M$ contre 648,8 M$.
controles.verbatim_source: For the three months ended June 30, 2026, Mosaic incurred a net loss of $272.8 million, or $(0.86) per diluted share, compared to net income of $410.7 million, or $1.29 per diluted share / Gross margin percentage 8% 17%

controles.affirmation: Marge brute du segment Phosphates : 'en baisse de 104,5 points sur un an'
controles.verbatim_source: Gross margin as a percentage of net sales — % 9 % (tableau segment Phosphate, T2 2026 vs T2 2025) ; Gross margin $(4.5) contre $103.0
controles.correction_proposee: Confusion entre variation relative et points de pourcentage. La marge passe de 9% a -0,4%, soit une baisse de 9,4 points (et non 104,5). Les -104,5% correspondent a la variation relative de la marge brute en dollars.

controles.affirmation: Cout du soufre +149,8% a 522 $/t et ammoniac +39,6% a 621 $/t ; conflit au Moyen-Orient et attaques sur les infrastructures russes et ukrainiennes.
controles.verbatim_source: Sulfur (long ton) $522 $209 $313 150% ; Ammonia (metric tonne) $621 $445 ; The continued conflict in the Middle East and attacks on the Russian and Ukraine commodities industrial assets have restricted exports

controles.affirmation: Dette nette 5,56 Mds $ (+35%) et levier 5,65x 'en hausse de 150% sur la periode'
controles.verbatim_source: Bilan 10-Q : Short-term debt $1,021.3 + Current maturities of long-term debt 66.7 + Long-term debt 4,767.7 - Cash 294.0 = 5,561.7 M$ (dette nette confirmee). Aucun ratio de levier ni de comparaison annuelle dans le 10-Q ; le signal du KPI leverage_q compare lui-meme a fin mars 2026 (4,25x), pas a un an.
controles.correction_proposee: Retirer '+150% sur la periode' ou preciser explicitement qu'il s'agit d'un calcul Mettrik non present dans le filing, avec la base de comparaison.

controles.affirmation: Le paiement final du PDG Bruce Bodine a ete limite a 50,0% de son objectif 'contre un potentiel de 114,0% avant cet ajustement'
controles.verbatim_source: Tableau DEF14A 2026 : Corporate Goals Attainment 34.5% | Discretionary Safety Adjustment (7.3)% | Corporate Goals Attainment After Safety Adjustment 27.2% | Individual Strategic Goal Attainment (20% wtg.) 114.0% | Total Payout % 50.0%
controles.correction_proposee: Les 114,0% sont l'atteinte des objectifs strategiques individuels (ponderee a 20%), pas un potentiel de paiement avant ajustement. Ecrire : 'la reduction discretionnaire a ramene l'atteinte des objectifs corporate de 34,5% a 27,2%, pour un paiement final de 50,0% de l'objectif'.

controles.affirmation: Reduction discretionnaire apres accident mortel : taux corporate de tous les dirigeants ramene de 34,5% a 27,2%.
controles.verbatim_source: the Compensation and Human Resources Committee exercised negative discretion to reduce the awards paid to NEOs due to a safety incident which resulted in a fatality (DEF14A 2026-04-16) ; tableau : 34.5% -> 27.2% pour chaque NEO
